articles.title: IAAPA Expo 2026 Sets Record with 39,000+ Attendees and 1,400 Exhibitors
articles.summary: IAAPA Expo 2026 was the largest in the event's history, drawing over 39,000 attendees and nearly 1,400 exhibiting companies across 634,000 square feet of exhibit space. The scale signals strong investment momentum and supplier activity across the attractions and FEC industry. For FEC operators, the record turnout reflects broad industry confidence and a wealth of new products and partnerships to evaluate.

articles.title: 2026 IAAPA Brass Ring Award Winners Announced for Best Exhibit and Best New Product
articles.summary: The 2026 IAAPA Brass Ring Awards recognized top innovations in attractions and products, continuing a tradition dating back to the 1800s carousel era. These awards highlight the industry's most impactful new offerings across rides, technology, and entertainment. FEC operators and suppliers should take note of winning products as benchmarks for guest experience investment.

articles.title: Triotech Unveils Five New Products at IAAPA Expo 2026 in Largest Launch in Company History
articles.summary: Triotech, a leading developer of interactive and immersive attractions, debuted five new products at IAAPA Expo 2026, marking its biggest product release ever. The company's portfolio is frequently adopted by FECs seeking medium-footprint, high-engagement attractions. Operators looking to refresh or expand their attraction mix should closely review Triotech's new lineup.

articles.title: Zero Latency VR Launches Jumanji: The Lost Levels at Venues Worldwide
articles.summary: Zero Latency VR, the world's largest free-roam VR network, has opened bookings for Jumanji: The Lost Levels, available at its venues globally from December 4, 2026. The branded IP experience targets adventurers of all ages, expanding Zero Latency's appeal to family audiences. FEC operators with or considering free-roam VR installations should evaluate this title as a proven IP draw.

articles.title: Great Wolf Lodge UK Resort Wins Planning Approval in Derbyshire
articles.summary: Bolsover District Council has approved plans for a Great Wolf Lodge resort in Derbyshire featuring a 512-room hotel, indoor water park, adventure park, and family entertainment facilities. The approval marks a major step in Great Wolf Resorts' expansion into the UK market and signals growing investor appetite for large-scale indoor family entertainment in Europe. Competing FEC and leisure operators in the UK should prepare for a significant new entrant.

articles.title: Alterface Debuts Ultra-Low Latency Interactive Technology at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: Alterface showcased its latest interactive attraction technology at IAAPA Expo 2026, featuring ultra-low latency of just 30 milliseconds and high-precision tracking for highly responsive guest interactions. The system also gives attraction designers greater creative freedom in building interactive experiences. FEC operators investing in shooting galleries, dark rides, or interactive games should evaluate Alterface's new platform.

articles.title: ProSlide Commits $15 Million R&D Investment to Next-Generation Attraction Technology
articles.summary: ProSlide Technology has announced a $15 million investment in research and development focused on water coaster technology, PowerRAPIDS river systems, and immersive water slide features. The commitment signals the company's intent to lead innovation in water attractions as parks seek differentiated guest experiences. FEC operators with water park components or planning future water attractions should monitor ProSlide's pipeline closely.

articles.title: Elev8 Fun Overhauling Attractions at Seminole Towne Center FEC
articles.summary: Elev8 Fun is undertaking a major overhaul of its attractions at Seminole Towne Center, refreshing its entertainment offering to drive renewed guest traffic. Attraction refreshes at mall-based FECs are a critical strategy for maintaining relevance as consumer expectations evolve. This move highlights the ongoing trend of FEC operators investing in experience upgrades to compete with other entertainment options.

articles.title: Slick City Action Park Expands with New San Antonio Location
articles.summary: Slick City Action Park, the indoor slide and adventure park concept, is opening a new location in San Antonio, continuing its national expansion. The brand has been aggressively targeting secondary and tertiary markets with its unique slide-focused FEC format. Operators should take note of Slick City's growth strategy as it intensifies competition in the indoor active entertainment segment.

articles.title: Slick City to Open New Boise Location on Milwaukee Street
articles.summary: Slick City is set to open another new indoor action park in Boise, Idaho, further accelerating its multi-market expansion strategy. The brand's rapid rollout underscores the strong consumer demand for active indoor entertainment alternatives to traditional FEC formats. Existing FEC operators in markets where Slick City is entering should assess the competitive implications for their venues.

articles.title: Slick City Considers Former Marsh Building for Fort Wayne Indoor Park
articles.summary: Slick City is evaluating a former Marsh grocery building in Fort Wayne, Indiana, as a potential site for a new indoor action park. The brand's willingness to repurpose large retail and commercial spaces is a notable trend in FEC real estate strategy. Operators and real estate investors should track Slick City's expansion as a model for adaptive reuse in the entertainment sector.

articles.title: EAG360 Announces Strong Speaker Lineup for January Seminar Programme
articles.summary: The organizers of EAG360, the amusements and gaming trade show, have revealed a curated seminar programme featuring senior industry leaders including the President of Euromat and the CEO of 501. The sessions will be integrated into the show floor across three days, offering operators direct access to insights from top executives. FEC operators and suppliers attending EAG360 in January should plan around this educational programming.

articles.title: Woozone to Exhibit Indoor Playground and Trampoline Park Equipment at IAAPA Expo Europe 2027
articles.summary: Chinese manufacturer Woozone has confirmed its presence at IAAPA Expo Europe 2027 in Vienna, where it will showcase its indoor playground, trampoline park, and related equipment. The show runs September 21-23, 2027, at VIECON Messe Wien. FEC operators planning European sourcing trips or equipment refreshes should mark this event and Woozone's booth on their calendars.

articles.title: WhiteWater's Helix Twist Wins IAAPA Brass Ring Award for Best New Product 2026
articles.summary: WhiteWater's Helix Twist, the world's first water slide with a physically twisting flume profile that creates a disorienting optical illusion, won the Best New Product Brass Ring Award at IAAPA Expo 2026. The slide made its debut at The Land of Legends in Antalya and introduces a new category of multi-sensory water slide experience. FEC operators with water park elements should take note of Helix Twist as a differentiation tool for their attractions portfolio.

articles.title: ProSlide PowerRAPIDS Wins Best New Water Ride at IAAPA Brass Ring Awards 2026
articles.summary: ProSlide's PowerRAPIDS attraction at Aquatopia Water Park in Vietnam was named Best New Water Ride at the 2026 IAAPA Brass Ring Awards, marking the company's 18th first-place nomination in this category. The ride combines family rafting with elevated river rapid moments and dark enclosed sequences to maximize guest surprise and excitement. Water park operators seeking next-generation family ride experiences should evaluate the PowerRAPIDS system.

articles.title: Universal Horror Unleashed Showcases Year-Round Immersive Scare Experience at Area15
articles.summary: Universal's first-ever year-round horror attraction, opened at Area15 in Las Vegas in August 2025, features four haunted houses, themed live entertainment zones, and horror-themed food and beverage. Speaking at Blooloop's 2026 Festival of Innovation, GM Kim Scott discussed the growing consumer demand for immersive scare experiences and elevated F&B pairings. FEC operators can draw key lessons from this model on year-round programming of themed immersive events beyond seasonal Halloween windows.

articles.title: UK's First Human Claw Machine Opens in Leicester, Highlighting Indoor Entertainment Innovation
articles.summary: Leicester has opened the UK's first human claw machine attraction, part of a broader wave of novelty indoor entertainment concepts taking root in the city centre. The activation reflects growing consumer appetite for quirky, shareable, social media-friendly FEC experiences. Operators looking for low-cost, high-buzz attraction additions should consider how novelty concepts like this can drive traffic and word-of-mouth.

articles.title: Omaha Building Eyed for Conversion to Indoor Entertainment Venue
articles.summary: A property at 3002 Dodge Street in Omaha, Nebraska, is under consideration for conversion into an indoor entertainment venue. The development represents the ongoing trend of repurposing commercial real estate for FEC and entertainment use in mid-sized US markets. Operators and investors tracking expansion opportunities in secondary markets should monitor this development.

articles.title: Mellors Group Expands UK FEC and Theme Park Portfolio with Lightwater Valley Takeover
articles.summary: The Mellors Group, a fourth-generation UK amusement and leisure operator, has taken over Lightwater Valley in North Yorkshire, adding it to a portfolio that includes Fantasy Island, Skegness Pier, a Manchester FEC, and a London competitive socialising venue. The group, which also manufactures rides and operates over 200 rides worldwide, employs up to 1,000 staff at peak periods. This profile offers FEC operators insight into a successful multi-format leisure operator blending traditional FEC with competitive socialising and event-based entertainment.

articles.title: 'The Gallery' Mixed-Use Development Wins TIF Approval in Madison County
articles.summary: A development called 'The Gallery' in Madison County has received Tax Increment Financing plan approval, with a family entertainment center component as part of the broader mixed-use project. TIF financing is an increasingly common tool used to fund FEC-anchored retail and entertainment developments. Operators and developers exploring public financing mechanisms for new venues should follow this project as a case study.

articles.title: HIVE Media Control Technology Synchronizes Projection at Hunderfossen Attraction
articles.summary: Dutch AV integrator Pro-Vision AV deployed HIVE Media Control technology alongside BoldMove Nation to deliver high-quality, synchronized multi-projection at a new Hunderfossen attraction in Norway. Synchronized projection systems are increasingly critical for immersive dark rides and themed walk-through experiences at FECs and theme parks. Operators planning immersive attraction builds should evaluate HIVE as part of their AV technology stack.

articles.title: Brogent Expands Global Partnerships with United Parks, Toho, Sony, and Grupo Iter
articles.summary: Brogent, a leading manufacturer of flying theater and immersive ride systems, has announced new partnerships with United Parks, Grupo Iter, Toho, and Sony to develop new attractions. The collaborations span North America, Latin America, and Asia, broadening Brogent's reach across diverse market segments. FEC and attraction operators seeking large-format immersive ride experiences should note Brogent's growing IP partnership network.

articles.title: Moment Factory Opens World-First Year-Round Immersive Night Walk in a Cemetery
articles.summary: Moment Factory has launched Ancestra Lumina in Montreal, the first permanent Lumina Enchanted Night Walk installed in a cemetery, blending light, sound, and storytelling in an unconventional outdoor setting. The project builds on the studio's proven Lumina format which has been adopted globally for nighttime nature and heritage walks. FEC operators running outdoor or seasonal nighttime experiences can draw inspiration from Moment Factory's approach to monetizing non-traditional spaces year-round.

articles.title: Cinemark Reports Record Q3 Momentum in Earnings Call
articles.summary: Cinemark highlighted record third-quarter performance during its latest earnings call, signaling strong consumer demand for out-of-home entertainment. The cinema chain's results are a positive indicator for the broader location-based entertainment sector, as box office recovery continues to lift foot traffic to entertainment destinations. FEC operators and investors can interpret Cinemark's momentum as a broader sign of consumer willingness to spend on experiential outings.

articles.title: VidantaWorld's BON Luxury Theme Park Adds New Attraction and Animatronic with Garner Holt and Mack Rides
articles.summary: VidantaWorld's BON luxury theme park is adding a new attraction and animatronic developed in collaboration with Garner Holt Productions and Mack Rides, raising the bar for high-end themed entertainment in resort settings. The partnership highlights how premium FEC and theme park developers are combining world-class ride manufacturers with specialist animatronic designers. Operators building premium entertainment experiences should study this collaboration as a model for delivering memorable, story-driven attractions.

articles.title: Episodia Themed Parks Launch in Poland and Romania with Major IP Partnerships
articles.summary: Leisure Expert Group and Momentum Leisure are delivering creative design for two Episodia-branded theme parks in Gliwice, Poland, and Bucharest, Romania, featuring IP from Nickelodeon, Paramount, Studio 100, and the Smurfs. The Gliwice park, set to open in summer 2027, marks a significant expansion of immersive family entertainment in Central and Eastern Europe. FEC operators can note Episodia's multi-IP, story-chapter-based model as a compelling repeat-visit strategy for family audiences.

articles.title: Detroit's $2.2B Renaissance Center Redevelopment Includes Entertainment Venue Plans
articles.summary: Detroit is advancing a $2.2 billion plan to transform the Renaissance Center complex, with entertainment venue components included in the broader redevelopment of the city's skyline. Large-scale urban mixed-use redevelopments increasingly incorporate FEC and entertainment anchors to drive activation and foot traffic. Operators and investors in urban entertainment markets should monitor this project as an emerging opportunity.

articles.title: Querion Hypermedia Entertainment Park Concept Profiled
articles.summary: Blooloop has profiled Querion, a hypermedia entertainment park concept that blends digital media, interactivity, and physical attractions into a next-generation FEC format. The concept represents an emerging category of media-integrated entertainment venues that sit between traditional FECs and immersive experience centers. Operators exploring future-forward venue formats should study the Querion model for inspiration on integrating technology-driven storytelling.

articles.title: Wood Design Amusement Rides Delivers Spectacular Christmas Carousel for Intratuin Duiven
articles.summary: Wood Design Amusement Rides has completed a bespoke Christmas Carousel for Intratuin Duiven in the Netherlands, drawing large crowds and generating strong seasonal buzz. The ride showcases the growing demand for high-quality, crafted seasonal attraction installations at retail and garden center destinations. FEC operators running seasonal events should take note of how premium carousel installations can anchor holiday programming and drive repeat visits.

articles.title: Six Flags Great Adventure Launches Holiday in the Park with Community Initiatives and 2027 Opening Date
articles.summary: Six Flags Great Adventure has kicked off its Holiday in the Park seasonal event with a passholder preview, community giving initiatives, and a reveal of its 2027 opening date. The holiday event combines dazzling lights, seasonal entertainment, and ride experiences to extend the park's operating calendar into late autumn. FEC operators can draw lessons from Six Flags' approach to seasonal programming, community engagement, and passholder loyalty during the holiday period.
